reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is Double.toString(new java.util.Random().nextGaussian()).substring(2), which is attacker-controlled because the Random instance is insecure and the resulting string is used as a rememberMeKey for authentication persistence. Case TP: at least one alert-TP (both are TP).
